title: Add process cleanup on SIGINT/SIGTERM in loop runner
description: Register SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers in the loop runner to ensure clean process termination. Kill the AI backend child process, stop caffeinate, and write a partial session log before exiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing Ctrl+C (SIGINT) during loop kills the AI child process
Partial session log is written on SIGINT
No orphan AI processes remain after Ctrl+C
SIGTERM behaves the same as SIGINT

steps.description: Store reference to current child process in loop runner
steps.details: In runLoop, maintain a variable: `let currentProc: ChildProcess | null = null`. Set it when spawning: `currentProc = backend.spawn(...)`. Clear it when done.

In loop-runner.ts or in the command handler: `const handleSignal = async () => { if (currentProc) currentProc.kill('SIGTERM'); caffeinate.stop(caffProc); await appendSessionLog(...); process.exit(0) }; process.on('SIGINT', handleSignal); process.on('SIGTERM', handleSignal)`

Run rocket loop on a real project. Press Ctrl+C during an AI iteration. Verify: (1) no hanging processes with `ps aux | grep copilot`, (2) LOG.md is updated with partial session, (3) process exits cleanly.

technicalNotes: Signal handlers must be synchronous or use process.exit() — you can't reliably await async operations in signal handlers
Use process.exitCode = 0 and let the finally block run instead of process.exit() for cleaner cleanup
